question: Can a 64-parameter decoder-channel correction selected only from eight visible frames and a coarse Q1-FE weak defect improve one deterministic train record without future-truth access?
hypothesis: The trained B2 decoder exposes instance-specific fine-scale directions. A source-off Q1 weak residual plus observed-prefix fit can select a safe linear combination that improves future relative L2 while retaining exact zero-coefficient rollback.

literature_basis.work: A hybrid finite element/neural network solver and its application to the Poisson problem
literature_basis.mechanism_used: coarse FE state enriched by local learned fine-scale correction

literature_basis.work: A finite element-based physics-informed operator learning framework for spatiotemporal PDEs
literature_basis.mechanism_used: assembled Galerkin weak residual with discrete time integration
neural-operator fine-scale element embedded in a variational framework

discretization_disclosure.dataset_generator: 5 m LWC84 with fourth-order time integration, free top, three-sided CFS-CPML, then binomial5 restriction to the stored 10 m grid
discretization_disclosure.online_feature: source-off Q1 bilinear finite-element weak residual on a 4x coarsened stored grid
discretization_disclosure.interpretation: mismatched-discretization physics feature and objective, not truth supervision
discretization_disclosure.boundary_policy: exclude top boundary and stored-grid left/right/bottom CPML margins

adapter.parameterization: 64 coefficients scaling the frozen decoder channel responses
adapter.weak_residual_start: max(frame 8, first stored frame at source_t0 + 1.5/source_f0)

data.selection: deterministic first manifest record; no error-based selection
data.future_truth_policy: candidate is serialized and SHA256 hashed before target frames 8:64 are read

gates.static: Q1 matrices, constant/linear weak closure, zero-coefficient rollback, existing instance contracts all pass
gates.online_objective: accepted=true, adapted objective below parent, finite coefficients, correction ratio <=0.05
gates.train_future_diagnostic: adapted relative L2 no worse than parent and relative gain >=0.001
gates.failure_signal: reject this FE feature / decoder-channel basis before any multi-record run if any gate fails

rollback: additive train-only diagnostic; parent and all protected checkpoints remain read-only
claim_scope: A pass authorizes a balanced multi-record train pilot only. It is not validation, test_id, absolute-target, or deployment-runtime evidence.
